expectations.text: Requires the buyer's authorization before the lender is called and says whether it is in hand
expectations.evidence: 'Authorization needed: from the buyer (borrower), in writing, naming the caller and the subject property — not yet in hand.' 'The call does not happen until it is in hand.'

expectations.text: Gives a plain, truthful reason for the call: verifying financing terms stated in the LOI, at the ledger owner's request, with the buyer's authorization
expectations.evidence: 'I'm verifying the financing terms stated in a letter of intent for [property address], a 48-unit multifamily, at the request of the seller's side and with [buyer]'s authorization.'

expectations.text: Questions are factual and about the lender's own position, covering at least: direct lender or intermediary, where the loan stands, and days to close with the starting event
expectations.evidence: Stage (Q1) and days-to-close with event (Q2) are asked, but direct lender or intermediary is deliberately left off: 'Direct lender or placing; who decides | ... | Not on this sheet unless the bank volunteers it; second call if needed'. One of the three required topics is not asked.

expectations.text: Says what each answer would settle in the ledger
expectations.evidence: Each question has a 'Settles:' line ('Settles: lender timeline and anchor. Lets the stated 45 days be measured against the bank's own number') and the entries table maps unknowns to Q1-Q6.

expectations.text: Treats the LOI's financing statements as not verified until the lender confirms them
expectations.evidence: 'All three are the buyer's statements about the bank, and the bank's own position is not in the file.' Three rows 'NOT VERIFIED (not checked)'.
No debt terms, price, rate, date or other input is supplied beyond the prompt; no number is derived.
'Verified: nothing.' Count '0 verified, 3 not verified ..., 8 unknown'. 'A buyer naming a lender verifies only that the buyer said it.'

'let the bank state its own figure before any LOI figure is read to it'; May share limited to property, existence of LOI naming the bank, and the basis of the call; 'Anything further ... only as the ledger owner authorizes'. Line B questions are conditioned: 'same call if the bank has issued terms; otherwise these stay open'.
'The financing clause, any financing contingency, and how days are counted are for the document and for counsel.' PSA date: 'not the bank's fact — counsel for each side'.
No pitch, advocacy, motive, value or recommendation; questions are confined to the bank's own position.

format_checks.evidence: After title and subject lines, 'Finding: Stated: ... Verified: nothing. ... Result: 3 entries are not verified and 8 are unknown'.
'Next verification: The buyer's written authorization ... Owner: seller's side requests it from the buyer.'
Eleven-row table with State column: three 'NOT VERIFIED (not checked)', eight 'UNKNOWN'; matches the count.
Last line: 'Work record: Evidence checked: none beyond your message | Calculations run: none | What changed: n/a'.
Tally stated in the Finding ('3 entries are not verified and 8 are unknown') and repeated in 'Count: 0 verified, 3 not verified (3 not checked, 0 do not hold), 8 unknown'.

Several missing facts lack what they would let the parties decide: 'Direct lender or placing; who decides | ... | Not on this sheet unless the bank volunteers it'; the 1031 item and the 'LOI text itself' item name only who to ask. Table results for unknowns are bare 'Q1'...'Q6' (the decision value is given under the questions).

notes: Careful on disclosure and on anchors, with a clean 0-verified ledger, but it identifies the direct-lender-or-placing fact as unknown and then chooses not to ask it. Count arithmetic checks (3+8=11 rows).
